Lakipia Wilderness
0
What sets Laikipia Wilderness apart is the sheer breadth of ways to experience the bush
Set in the heart of Ol Doinyo Lemboro, a 21,000-acre conservancy in Central Laikipia - one of Kenya's most varied and wildlife-rich landscapes - it offers a relaxed, unpretentious take on safari life. This is bush camping in its truest sense: personal, off-grid, and built for those who want an authentic, adventurous experience without the formality. Offering five unique accommodations each carrying the same easy, no-frills character and warm hospitality that guests keep coming back for.

Wildlife
Laikipia's largely unfenced landscape allows game to move freely with the rains, supporting an extraordinary range of species. The area is a stronghold for more than 70% of the world's remaining Grevy's zebra, alongside reticulated giraffe, Beisa oryx, zorilla, striped hyena, aardwolf, and wild dog. Large permanent populations of elephant, lion, leopard, spotted hyena, common zebra, warthog, hippo, buffalo, and numerous antelope species are also present, along with some 350 recorded bird species. A mammal and bird checklist is provided in the Laikipia Wilderness guest booklet.
Leopard Tracking - Laikipia boasts one of the highest leopard densities in Africa, and sightings here are exceptional.
